dataset.description:
This Data Management Plan outlines the lifecycle of the data generated during this FCT Advanced Computing Project. The project focuses on integrating OpenCL GPU processing into the blavaan R package to accelerate Bayesian Structural Equation Modeling (BSEM) estimation.

The purpose of this DMP is to define the protocols for managing the resulting R source code, the synthetic Monte Carlo simulation datasets, and the aggregated computational benchmarking metrics. It establishes the framework to ensure all project outputs adhere strictly to FAIR principles and the FCT Policy on Management and Sharing of Research Data. By implementing these data management strategies, we guarantee open access, proper version control, and long-term reproducibility of the computational psychometric tools developed during this grant.
dataset.title: Accelerating Bayesian Structural Equation Modeling via GPU Processing

dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP) outlines the lifecycle of the data generated during this FCT Advanced Computing Project. The project focuses on integrating OpenCL GPU processing into the blavaan R package to accelerate Bayesian Structural Equation Modeling (BSEM) estimation.

The purpose of this DMP is to define the protocols for managing the resulting Stan/R source code, the synthetic simulation datasets, and the aggregated computational benchmarking metrics. It establishes the framework to ensure all project outputs adhere strictly to FAIR principles and the FCT Policy on Management and Sharing of Research Data. By implementing these data management strategies, we guarantee open access, proper version control, and long-term reproducibility of the computational psychometric tools developed during this grant.

project.description: The Portuguese Foundation for Science and Technology (FCT) seeks to aggregate national advanced computing resources, promoting cooperation between the various centres involved and developing national and international partnerships with other entities. Under the terms of the Advanced Computing Projects Regulation, published under no. 10/2022 in the Diário da República, the allocation of national computing resources is made following a tender procedure whose terms are published on the FCT website.
